jobs.title: E Commerce Manager
jobs.description: We are looking for an E-commerce Manager to oversee daily operations and commercial execution of the company's e-commerce platforms. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure campaign execution, product availability, efficient fulfillment, customer experience, and online sales growth. This is an onsite position at Armal Compound 2, M. Eusebio Avenue, San Miguel, Pasig City. Key responsibilities Oversee the website development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the company’s e-commerce website. Implement and optimize SEO strategies to improve organic search rankings and drive traffic. Manage content updates to ensure relevance and engagement. Enhance site usability and ensure a seamless shopping experience by implementing best practices in UX/UI design. Utilize web analytics tools to monitor site performance, user behavior, and key metrics. Generate reports and insights to inform decision-making. Oversee the presence and performance on various online marketplaces like Zalora, Lazada, Shopee, Tiktok, and future emerging marketplaces the company ventures into. Ensure product listings are optimized for search and conversion, including titles, descriptions, images, and pricing. Maintain relationships with marketplace vendors, ensuring compliance with their guidelines and leveraging promotional opportunities. Develop and execute media plans to support e-commerce sales objectives, including digital advertising, PPC, and display ads marketing. Optimize Meta ads & CPAS to ensure cost-effective customer acquisition. Analyze data to improve ad spend efficiency and ROI. Plan and execute digital advertising campaigns across various platforms, including Google Ads, Facebook Ads, and display networks Continuously monitor media performance, making adjustments as needed to optimize results. Lead, analyze and strategize and mentor a team of e-commerce specialists, digital marketers, and support staff. Provide guidance, training, and performance evaluations.

jobs.title: Cashier, SM Sta. Rosa
jobs.description: We are looking for a Cashier to serve as an important control point in the completion of each customer purchase. This position will be reporting to work at SM Sta Rosa. You will report directly to the Store Supervisor Key responsibilities: Transaction Processing and Accuracy Process customer purchases accurately using POS system. Verify merchandise description, quantity, price, discounts, and transaction totals. Confirm that scanned merchandise corresponds to the actual items purchased. Apply only approved promotions, discounts, and transaction adjustments. Issue the required invoice or other approved transaction documents in accordance with company procedures and regulations. Immediately report pricing discrepancies, POS errors, and transaction irregularities. Payment Handling and Security Accept and process only company-approved payment methods. Follow prescribed procedures for cash, card, electronic wallet, and other authorized payment transactions. Verify payment completion before releasing merchandise. Safeguard cash, payment records, and assigned cashiering equipment. Prevent unauthorized access to POS accounts, cash drawers, and transaction records. Report suspected fraudulent transactions or payment irregularities. Customer Checkout Experience Greet and acknowledge customers courteously at the checkout counter. Process transactions with accuracy and reasonable efficiency. Explain payment, exchange, and other relevant policies clearly and respectfully. Address routine checkout inquiries and refer disputed matters to the Store Head. Thank customers sincerely and conclude transactions with the brand's customer service standards. Merchandise Verification and Packing Verify that all merchandise presented for payment has been correctly recorded in the transaction. Check merchandise condition and confirm that the correct items and quantities are released. Remove security tags or other applicable security devices following approved procedures. jobs.title: Business Development Specialist
jobs.description: The Business Development Specialist is responsible for driving client acquisition and revenue growth within the Philippines, focusing on small and medium enterprises (SMEs). This role handles inbound sales, ensuring consistent pipeline development and deal closures. The Senior Specialist works independently, managing the full sales cycle—from prospecting and lead qualification to negotiation and onboarding—while building strong relationships that support long-term client success. The Business Development Specialist also assists in upselling (proposals) and the renewal of existing clients. Key Responsibilities 1. Full-Cycle Sales & Pipeline Development Own and manage the entire sales pipeline, negotiating terms and closing new business. Handle inbound leads expertly, ensuring a rapid, professional response and a high lead-to-conversion rate. Craft compelling proposals and presentations tailored to the unique needs of prospective clients, effectively communicating our value proposition. 2. Strategic Account Growth & Client Relationships Cultivate and nurture long-term, strategic relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders within SME clients. Proactively identify and pursue opportunities for upselling and cross-selling within the existing client base, driving account expansion and contributing to client retention. Collaborate seamlessly with the Client Success and Operations teams to ensure a smooth and successful client onboarding experience, setting the stage for long-term partnership. 3. Market Intelligence & Strategy Continuously monitor market trends, competitor activities, and the evolving needs of the Philippine SME landscape to identify new opportunities and potential threats. Translate market insights into actionable recommendations for the Business Development leadership, influencing sales strategies, product offerings, and go-to-market approaches. 4. jobs.title: Human Resources Intern
jobs.description: The Organization & Employee Development Intern will support the HR team in employee engagement activities, training and development, and organization development. The role involves assisting with planning, coordination, documentation, and program support while gaining practical experience in HR operations and communication. Core Responsibilities: Documentation & Logistics Support: Assist in preparing HR program materials, coordinating event logistics, maintaining accurate records, organizing files, and communicating schedules and requirements to participants. Program Implementation Support: Support the execution of employee engagement and development activities by facilitating sessions, assisting speakers, monitoring program delivery, collecting feedback, and ensuring smooth event operations. Event Proposal Development: Help conceptualize and prepare employee engagement event proposals, conduct research, collaborate with stakeholders, create multimedia materials for internal communications, and develop a comprehensive event proposal from planning through execution.
